subject: Pricing & route mix: cost profile and step-up options
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Mitchell <ava@quantify.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:09:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing & route mix: cost profile and step-up options

Hi Ava — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can model blended economics for Quantify.ai: 

Summary from call:
- Q: Expected monthly token run-rate today: ~75M tokens (mostly embeddings + short generation).
- Q: Target 12mo growth profile: step-up to ~300M tokens with new chat route and reranking use case.
- Constraint: current budget target is ~$1,500 to $2,000 per 1M tokens effective across the stack (target $/1M tokens).
- Requirement: enterprise controls (audit logs, VPC) and mixed routing between hosted and dedicated for peak periods.

Immediate asks (so we can get a blended quote):
1) Can you confirm expected % of tokens that will be chat/generation vs embeddings vs reranking for months 0, 6, 12? A simple split (e.g., 60/30/10) is fine.
2) Any hard budget ceilings for year 1 or preferred phased budgets for the step-ups?
3) Who on your side will own procurement and invoicing (name & email) so we can include them on the procurement timeline?

I've attached the usage export you shared and a template we use to map route mixes to blended $/1M. If you prefer, we can run three blended scenarios (conservative/likely/aggressive) and include optional dedicated-reserve pricing for predictable throughput.

Next steps I propose:
- You reply with the token-split + procurement contact (this week)
- Redwood runs 3 blended scenarios and returns a short spreadsheet + one-slide summary (by Mon 4/26)
- 30-min follow-up to walk numbers and confirm preferred route mix (Tue/Wed next week)

Thanks — happy to tighten anything.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0172

Attachments: quantify_usage_export.csv (CSV), pricing-models-v2.xlsx (Excel)
From: Ava Mitchell <ava@quantify.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@quantify.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 17:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & route mix: cost profile and step-up options

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers below and a small correction on the numbers: 

Token splits (month 0 / month 6 / month 12):
- Generation/chat: 45% / 55% / 50%
- Embeddings: 40% / 30% / 35%
- Reranking/other: 15% / 15% / 15%

Budget guidance:
- FY1 preferred effective target: $1,200–$1,800 per 1M tokens (we know steady-state will vary by route; this is what finance is comfortable approving).
- If you can show the dedicated-reserve case that gets us to <$1,000 per 1M at our projected 300M run-rate, that would be compelling for leadership.

Procurement contact: Samir Rao (samir@quantify.ai) — he'll own the PO and cloud vendor checks.

One note on SLA: for reranking we need p95 latency <150ms for a chunk of traffic; if dedicated routing is necessary for that, flag it in your scenarios.

Happy to get the three scenarios and sync next week.

—Ava
Head of Product, Quantify.ai

- They provided token splits for 0/6/12 months (attached).
- Finance target FY1: $1.2k–$1.8k per 1M tokens.
- Procurement contact is Samir Rao (samir@quantify.ai).

3) Draft a 1-page procurement timeline and a slide to show delta to <$1k/1M at 300M tokens (if achievable).

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Mitchell <ava@quantify.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & route mix: cost profile and step-up options

Ava — thanks for the split and budget context. We ran three quick scenarios and attached a short spreadsheet + a one-pager (redwood-sla-summary.pdf). High level: 

Scenario highlights (effective $/1M tokens, blended):
- Conservative (hosted-only, no reserves): $1,650 / 1M (at expected 75M run-rate)
- Likely (hybrid: hosted + small dedicated for reranking): $1,320 / 1M (projected at mid growth)
- Aggressive (dedicated reserve + optimized quantization for embeddings): $950 / 1M (at 300M run-rate, requires 3–6mo commit on reserved capacity)

Notes:
- The aggressive case hits your <$1k target at scale but requires a committed reserved pool and a short rollout to quantize embeddings; we put the assumptions in the spreadsheet.
- For p95 <150ms on reranking we recommend a dedicated routing tier with autoscaling to avoid tail latency; included cost delta in the sheet.
- Attached is a sample procurement timeline (30–45 days typical) and a HubSpot link we can use to capture the deal milestones.

Next steps:
1) Ava/Samir: confirm whether Quantify will consider a 3–6mo reserved commit if we show the path to <$1k/1M at 300M tokens.
2) Dylan: schedule a 30-min walk-through next week to go over the spreadsheet and get procurement dates.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call to run the numbers live.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Phone: (212) 555-0189

Attachments: pricing-models-v2.xlsx (detailed scenarios), redwood-sla-summary.pdf (one-pager)
